name: LunR Royalties Corp.
description: LunR Royalties is a Lundin Group royalty and streaming company spun out of NGEx Minerals in December 2025, anchored by NSR royalties on two major undeveloped copper-gold projects—Lunahuasi and Los Helados—in the Vicuña District of Argentina and Chile. The company is growing its portfolio and has agreed to acquire a life-of-mine silver stream on Lundin Gold's Fruta del Norte gold mine in Ecuador. LunR offers investors pure-play royalty exposure to the Vicuña District without the capital and operating cost risks of mine ownership.
